answer: Because the mirror cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the crystal ledger, the opal audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 14 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Each copy needs 3 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
